summary: Frontend-only testing per request: PIN gates for Produk (1614) and Kasir (1515) tabs, and super-admin-only Admin management UI. All 26 assertions passed. Verified that non-super admin (skbike.id@store.com) does NOT see the Admin tab. Full CRUD on admin accounts (create/change-password/delete) works with proper toasts and confirm dialog. Super admin's delete button is disabled. TEST_ admins were cleaned up.

minor.issue: EXTRA_ADMINS (skbike.id@store.com) password is NOT re-synced from EXTRA_ADMINS on backend restart (only the super admin from env is). This is not a bug for prod, but during parallel testing a super admin can change the extra admin's password permanently, locking out the seeded credential until manually reset.

issues: Right-side 'Keluar' (logout) button is partially cut off by the toast area at 1920px viewport (see screenshots) - the button label 'Keluar' is truncated to 'Kelu'. Consider adjusting header padding or toast placement.

code_warnings.issue: React warning in console: 'Cannot update a component (AdminPanel) while rendering a different component (PinGate).' PinGate is calling onUnlock() (which triggers a setState in AdminPanel) inside its render/commit path via submit() called from press(). Wrap onUnlock invocation in a microtask (e.g. queueMicrotask or setTimeout 0) or move submit into a useEffect based on pin length to fix.

action_items: (Low) Fix React setState-during-render warning by deferring onUnlock() call in PinGate.jsx (e.g. wrap in setTimeout 0 or trigger via useEffect on pin length === 4).
(Low) Make EXTRA_ADMINS seeding idempotent - re-sync password from EXTRA_ADMINS on startup if it differs, matching the super admin behavior. Or document that extra admin password is only seeded once.
(Low, UI) Ensure the 'Keluar' logout button in the AdminPanel header is fully visible and not overlapped/truncated by toast notifications.
critical_code_review_comments: PinGate.jsx invokes onUnlock() synchronously inside the state updater path, causing a React setState-during-render warning. Defer with useEffect or setTimeout.

seed_admin() only re-syncs the primary admin password from env; extra admins' passwords are not resynced, which caused a temporary lockout during testing when a super admin changed the extra admin's password.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both PIN gates and the super-admin gating of the Admin tab are working correctly. If super admin login mysteriously starts failing with 401, restart backend (sudo supervisorctl restart backend) - the primary admin password is re-synced from env on startup. If the extra admin (skbike.id@store.com) password fails, it must be reset manually via PUT /api/admin/admins/{id}/password because seed_admin does NOT re-sync extra admin passwords. Parallel test agents can cause interference - watch for it. React setState-in-render warning is present but non-blocking.
rca of the issue: N/A - all functional tests passed. Environmental note: mid-test the super admin login broke because a concurrent test session on another IP changed the super admin password via PUT /api/admin/admins/{super_id}/password. Fixed by restarting backend (which re-syncs the super password from ADMIN_PASSWORD env). Extra admin password had to be manually reset via API.
